findings.observation: binding_energy cites source 'legacy_fit.py@605309f', which matches neither the declared inputs in metadata.yml (geometries/022.xyz, scripts/run_022.py) nor code_version 'c022beef'; the headline quantity appears to originate from an undeclared legacy fit rather than the declared PBE0/def2-SVP counterpoise run, so identifiers and method provenance in results.json contradict metadata.yml.

Prose reports 'a repulsive 5.52 kcal/mol' while results.json records binding_energy = -5.52 kcal/mol; a negative binding energy denotes an attractive (bound) interaction, so the sign and physical interpretation in the prose contradict the recorded quantity.

Prose states the calculation was performed 'at PBE/def2-SVP' whereas metadata.yml declares functional 'PBE0' (also stated in the objective); the method in the prose contradicts the method in the metadata.

Judgement call not covered by a data rule: |binding_energy| = 5.52 kcal/mol is roughly an order of magnitude larger than typical counterpoise-corrected values for the methane-water complex (~0.5-1 kcal/mol), which corroborates the finding that the value stems from the undeclared legacy fit rather than the declared PBE0/def2-SVP computation. Convergence (CA-METH-002), unit/source presence (CA-DATA-001), self-description fields (CA-REPRO-001) and exclusion statements were checked and found consistent.
